name: stellarhub
description: Lanzador de juegos para Linux inspirado en PlayNite

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run watch:main" "npm run watch:renderer" --kill-others --success first
scripts.watch: concurrently "npm run watch:main" "npm run watch:renderer" "wait-on dist/main/main.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
